reason: A right-side panel plugin for running isolated agent chats alongside a main conversation, with configurable context inheritance and controlled reply insertion back into the main composer.

summaries.zh: 在主对话旁提供独立的侧边智能体聊天面板，支持暂存选中文本、管理新聊天并将回复或摘要带回主对话。
summaries.en: Provides an independent side-panel agent chat for staging selected text, starting new conversations, and bringing replies or summaries back into the main conversation.

capabilities: creates and manages independent side-chat agent sessions
inherits selected main-conversation context and workspace settings
stages selected text for side-chat prompts without sending by default
inserts side-chat replies or summaries into the main conversation draft or context
